Author: Aki
Name: StockTracker
Punchline: Know which crafted items sold and need to be recrafted.
Description: Maintain one or more named lists of items you craft and sell, each with a target stock quantity. StockTracker watches the item's total market listing quantity across all of your retainers combined (via Allagan Tools, if installed) and automatically builds a 'needs recraft' list whenever a tracked item's total stock drops below its target - clearing it again once you restock. Optionally adds a right-click entry to the Crafting Log to add the selected recipe straight to a list (toggle in Settings). Export the needs-recraft list straight to Artisan's crafting list format via the clipboard. Commands: /stocktracker, /st. Requires Allagan Tools (InventoryTools).
